## What Changed

[1.23.0] 2026 10 22 Added agent framework a2a : Add allowlisted forwarding of function invocation and client arguments from A2A request metadata ( 9193) agent framework core , agent framework orchestrations : Add an opt in synthetic trailing user turn for providers that return empty text after assistant ending prompts ( 8779) Changed agent framework , agent framework ag ui , agent framework core , agent framework declarative , agent framework foundry hosting , agent framework hosting mcp , agent framework lab : [BREAKING] Add the MCP 2.x compatibility foundation and migrate MCP transports, errors, schemas, and lifecycle handling ( 9236) agent framework ag ui , agent framework core : [BREAKING] Require an explicit AG UI authorization scope or single user declaration for endpoint registration ( 9413) agent framework tools : [BREAKING] Rename Docker shell extra run args to unsafe extra run args and make its trust requirements explicit ( 9453) agent framework tools : Raise the psutil floor to the first release with Windows ABI3 wheels for the supported Python range. agent framework , agent framework core : Advance the exact Core pin and standard install dependency cohort to the pack...
